## Stephen Amell as Garrett
### Garrett Has Telekinetic Powers
In the first movie, Garrett is a mid-level operative within Marcus Suttcliffe's drug operation. Eager to elevate his position and expand his opportunities, he recruits Connor into his gang for several high-profile crimes. Though his level is never expressly offered, **Garrett is designated a TK - meaning he has telekinetic abilities** and can move things with his mind. By the second movie, he has taken control of the drug operation, trying to run it ethically, but ends up battling crooked cops in Lincoln City.
As well as being the cousin of Robbie, Stephen Amell is best known for his work in the Arrowverse, starring as Oliver Queen/Green Arrow in _Arrow_ for eight seasons. He also briefly appeared in _New Girl_ and had a starring role in _Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Out of the Shadows_ as Casey Jones. He also starred in the professional wrestling series _Heels_ on _Starz_ as the lead character, Jack Spade. Amell next appears in the _Suits_ spinoff series, _Suits LA_.

## Who Else Is In Code 8?
**Sung Kang is Alex Park**, the father to a powered daughter. The straight-laced detective finds himself on the trail of the gang. When it comes to _Code 8_ powers, he has none. Kang is best known as Han Lue in the _Fast and Furious_ franchise. Kang also voiced Dung Hai in _Raya and the Last Dragon_, played Assistant U.S. Attorney John Mak in _Power_, and took on the role of The Fifth Brother in the Star Wars spinoff, _Obi-Wan Kenobi_​​​​​.
**Aaron Abrams is Davis**, Park's morally flexible detective partner. **Davis is one of the characters who also returned in the sequel**, as he helped Connor and Garrett once again, exposing the crooked cops in Lincoln City. He also has no _Code 8_ powers. Abrams is best known for his recurring role as crime scene investigator Brian Zeller on NBC's _Hannibal_. He also starred as Matthew Weitz in _Blindspot_, and James in _Children Ruin Everything_. He also wrote and produced the Netflix comedy movie, _The Lovebirds_.
**Kari Matchett is Mary Reed**, Connor's mother. Mary is designated a Cryo, meaning **she can produce and manipulate ice**. Her terminal illness, however, renders her powers unstable, and that is why Connor starts working with criminals, as he needs help to afford her surgery. Matchett previously had prominent roles in such shows as _24_ (as Lisa Miller) and _ER_ (as Skye Wexler). She has also earned award nominations for the Canadian TV shows _Power Play, Blue Murder,_ and _Fortunate Son_.
**Greg Bryk is Marcus Sutcliffe**,the head of the Psyke drug organization plaguing Lincoln City. Sutcliffe is Garrett's boss and designated a Reader - **meaning he can hear people's thoughts**. Bryk starred in the ill-fated _V-Wars_ on Netflix. He also starred in the lead role in the werewolf series, _Bitten_. He also appeared in the movie _My Spy_ with Dave Bautista, _Ad Astra_ with Brad Pitt, and in the horror movie, _Saw 3D_.

In 2016, Robbie and Stephen Amell released a short film, _Code 8_, which acted as a teaser for a potential feature film. An Indiegogo fundraising campaign asking for $200,000 was launched on March 23 and reached $2.4 million by April 24.[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Code_8_(2019_film)#cite_note-Indiegogo-3) Fundraising closed with $3.4 million on December 31, 2019, with the continued campaign helping recover costs of DVD pressings and the distribution to contributors of perks, wardrobe, and props from the production.[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Code_8_(2019_film)#cite_note-Indiegogo-3) A four-minute segment of the film's closing credits shows a list of only some of the 30,810 contributors[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Code_8_(2019_film)#cite_note-Indiegogo-3) to the fundraising campaign.

**Green Arrow** is a superhero who appears in American comic books published by DC Comics. Created by Mort Weisinger and designed by George Papp, he first appeared in _More Fun Comics_ #73 on September 19, 1941 (cover dated November 1941), the same issue that debuted Aquaman. His real name is **Oliver Jonas Queen**, a wealthy businessman, owner of Queen Industries, and a well-known celebrity in Star City. He uses this position to hide the fact that he is Green Arrow.[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Green_Arrow#cite_note-dc-ency-1) Partly inspired by Robin Hood, Green Arrow is an archer who uses his skills to fight crime in his home cities of Star City and Seattle, as well as alongside his fellow superheroes as a member of the Justice League. The world's greatest archer, as well as a competent swordsman and martial artist, Green Arrow deploys a range of trick arrows (in contemporary times, they are referred as "specialty arrows"[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Green_Arrow#cite_note-2)) with various special functions, such as glue, explosive-tipped, grappling hook, flash grenade, tear gas, and even kryptonite arrows for use in a range of special situations.

Source: https://www.dc.com/characters/green-arrow
Title: Green Arrow | Official DC Character
Chunks: 0,1,2,3
Billionaire Oliver Queen uses both his wealth and his unmatched archery skills as the Justice League's battling bowman, Green Arrow.
Although he is commonly thought of by many as just a modern-day Robin Hood, the Green Arrow is so much more than that limited description would lead you to believe. Born to a life of wealth and privilege, Oliver Queen took it all for granted until tragedy struck at sea, leaving him alone on a deserted island. There, Queen had to dig deep to find out if he had the inner fortitude to survive. While stranded on this island, Oliver honed his already formidable archery skills into becoming the greatest archer ever known.
When he finally returned to civilization, he embarked on a career as an urban vigilante, attempting to rid the streets of his hometown of Seattle, and also Star City, from crime and corruption with nothing but a bow and arrow. Viewed as a pampered playboy by the outside world, Green Arrow cares more about the plight of the poor and the suffering in America perhaps more than any other costumed superhero—a “social justice warrior” in the truest sense of the word.
Although an imperfect man, prone to make mistakes in his personal life probably more than most other costumed crusaders, the Green Arrow is nevertheless one of the greatest heroes in the entire DC Universe. Whether fighting solo, with his paramour the Black Canary or with his fellow heroes of the Justice League, the Emerald Archer is one hero anyone would be lucky to have at their back.
